# Input для image-prompt — generate Midjourney prompt

## Brief

Cover image для статьи "Why AI is changing engineering teams in 2026".

## Constraints

- Target model: Midjourney v6 with `--style raw`
- Style: editorial photo (not illustration, not 3D)
- Aspect ratio: 16:9 (article header)
- Mood: thoughtful, slightly dramatic, not too techy
- Subject: an engineer at a desk with code on screen, late-afternoon light
- NO text in image (we'll overlay title separately)
- NO real-person likeness

## Expected formula application

subject + setting + style + lighting + camera + texture + MJ params + negative
